title: Describe a Club Plan
instructions: Read and record the model without reading headings. After pronunciation feedback, give your own answer.
prompt: Describe a real or imagined club or small group. Explain when and where it meets, why you want to attend, one activity, what you will do if you are busy, and one polite request. Speak for about 75–105 seconds.
reference: Hello, my name is Nora. I am a new member of an English club at my language school. We plan to meet again in Room 5 on Wednesday morning. I want to attend because I would like to speak with visitors at work. Our team makes a welcome poster and practices short questions. If I am busy, I will send Maya a message and choose another time. I can ask, “Can you tell me where the room is, please?” I feel more confident when I practice with other people.
